MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The epoxy fits my recent repair and fastening tasks because it could bond parts that screws cannot secure.",
    "The adhesive mounting strips fit my interest in anchors and mounting supplies by offering a way to attach lightweight objects removably."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Relay harnesses and electrical connectors require a wiring project I have not shown a need for; buying construction fasteners does not make these useful to me now.",
    "The threaded inserts and half-inch washers serve specific connections that do not match my recent screws and anchors.",
    "Precision calipers address a measuring need I do not currently have, while twelve wastebaskets exceed my household needs."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in nails, screws, and anchors seems to have been treated as interest in almost any workshop supply.",
    "Buying some supplies in bulk seems to have been stretched into assuming that large quantities are useful regardless of the item or task."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The purpose and dimensions of fastening supplies matter to me: a related item is useful only if it fits the connection I need to make.",
    "My recent purchases include household consumables as well as construction supplies, so they do not establish a need for specialized automotive or precision measuring equipment.",
    "I choose items for an immediate task; something that might be handy someday is not enough reason for me to buy it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my repair and mounting needs but extended them too broadly to specialized equipment and quantities I do not need."
}
